articles.title: Spain to introduce temporary border checks on visitors from Italy
articles.description:
Move comes in response to Rome imposing similar measures after mass migration rush to Ceuta
Spain has announced it will introduce temporary border checks on visitors from Italy in response to Rome imposing similar measures after a mass rush of people from Morocco into Ceuta.
The checks, which come “amid the persistent irregular migration pressure” facing Italy, will start at midnight on Saturday and last until 7 September, Spain’s interior ministry said in a statement.

articles.title: Judge approves Trump effort to end South Sudan TPS protections
articles.description:
Decision follows supreme court ruling that allowed US government to strip protections for Haitians and Syrians
Temporary protected status (TPS) for hundreds of South Sudanese nationals in the United States is set to end after a federal judge ruled that the Trump administration can move forward with stripping their protections.
On Friday, US district judge Patti Saris of the district of Massachusetts rejected an attempt by immigrant rights organizations including the New York-based African Communities Together to keep TPS for South Sudanese nationals living in the US.

articles.title: Ebola virus behind massive outbreak in DRC could be mutating, officials say
articles.description:
Cases have passed 4,000 and health watchdog plans to go door to door to find patients in major response escalation
The virus causing a massive outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo could be mutating, health officials fear, as confirmed cases pass 4,000.
Africa’s public health watchdog said the time for incremental action was over as they announced plans to scale up every aspect of the response and go “door to door” looking for patients.

articles.titleJa: コンゴ民主共和国での大規模なエボラ出血熱、ウイルスが変異している可能性と当局
articles.summary: コンゴ民主共和国で4,000件を超えるエボラ出血熱の大規模な発生があり、ウイルスが変異している可能性が懸念されている。公衆衛生当局は、患者を発見するため戸別訪問を含む対応の強化を発表した。

articles.title: US to shut five consulates as critics fear China could fill diplomatic vacuum
articles.description:
State department informs Congress of planned closures in Canada, Grenada, Japan, Indonesia and Cameroon
The US state department is to shut five foreign consulates and missions across Asia, Africa, North America and the Caribbean, drawing criticism that it is leaving a diplomatic vacuum at risk of being filled by China.
The US Congress has been served notice of the impending closures, which are being justified on cost grounds and follow a reassessment of the US’s bilateral relationships with a range of countries since Donald Trump returned to the White House in January 2025.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 米国、5つの領事館閉鎖へ 中国が外交的空白を埋めることを批評家が懸念

articles.title: Top Ugandan footballer killed by robbers armed with paving stones
articles.description:
David Owori, who played for the national team, died in hospital after he tried to stop robbers taking his phone
The Ugandan football community is in mourning after the death of a player who was fatally injured during a robbery in the capital, Kampala, on Tuesday night.
David Owori, who captained Sports Club Villa, a Uganda Premier League club, and represented the national team, was attacked after resisting an attempt to steal his mobile phone and other belongings near his home in Makindye division.
 Continue reading...

articles.title: ‘Shoved the tube so hard it tore my nose’: Kurdish film-maker recounts ‘inhumane’ ICE force-feeding
articles.description:
Gabar Choli tells of how, for months, he was shackled, pinned and forcibly fed – and the physical and emotional scars the ordeal has left
In June 2025, a sluggish and thin Gabar Choli, with sunken temples and bones visible under his skin, braced himself for the immigration detention center guards to charge into his cell once again.
Choli was in a solitary confinement medical cell inside the Port Isabel service processing center, an Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) detention facility in south Texas where immigrants arrested in Donald Trump’s anti-immigration crackdown are detained.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 「チューブを強く押し込まれ鼻が裂けた」：クルド人映画製作者が語るICEによる「非人道的」強制摂食
articles.summary: 米国テキサス州の移民収容施設で、クルド人映画製作者ガバル・チョリ氏が数ヶ月にわたり経験した「非人道的」な強制摂食について語った。チョリ氏は、身体的・精神的な傷跡が残されたと訴えている。

articles.title: Kurdish hunger striker says ICE force-feeding ‘mentally broke me’
articles.description:
Exclusive: Film-maker Gabar Choli describes how he endured coercive treatment over eight months in detention in Texas
A Kurdish man who was force fed over the course of eight months while on hunger strike in US immigration detention has spoken out about it for the first time, describing how much the process harmed him physically and psychologically.
Gabar Choli, a film-maker and activist now living in Canada after being deported, described how he endured the coercive treatment – a practice widely considered torture by international human rights groups – often twice a day after being detained by US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) when his asylum application was denied.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: クルド人ハンガーストライカー、ICEの強制摂食が「精神的に私を破壊した」と語る
articles.summary: 米国の移民収容施設で8ヶ月間強制摂食を受けたクルド人映画製作者ガバル・チョリ氏が、その経験が肉体的・精神的に大きな苦痛を与えたと語った。この行為は国際的な人権団体から拷問と見なされている。

articles.title: Canadian government steps in as ‘out of control’ wildfires force thousands to flee
articles.description:
British Columbia battling 102 fires day and night across province, as breakneck speed hampers firefighters’ efforts
Canada’s federal government has announced it will provide urgent assistance to British Columbia after an onslaught of unprecedented fast-moving wildfires that killed one person and forced about 22,000 people to flee their homes in frantic evacuations.
A total of 102 wildfires were raging across the province on Sunday, of which nearly half were categorised as “out of control”, according to the BC Wildfire Service. Of those fires, 78 ignited during the past week.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: カナダ政府、「制御不能」な山火事で数千人が避難する中介入

articles.title: Costa Rican diplomat emerges as strong contender to be first female head of UN
articles.description:
Rebeca Grynspan seen as continuity candidate with tacit support from current secretary general, António Guterres
A Costa Rican diplomat and former vice-president whose parents were refugees from the Holocaust has become the surprise frontrunner to lead the United Nations as its first female secretary general.
Rebeca Grynspan, whose parents emigrated to Central America from Poland – and whose maternal grandparents were killed by the Nazis – is the current head of the UN conference on trade and development (UNCTAD), a body that has exhaustively tallied the economic damage inflicted by Israel’s occupation of the Palestinian territories.
 Continue reading...

articles.title: ‘I couldn’t breathe’: the deadly health burden of wildfire smoke
articles.description:
Scientists race to untangle complex links between exposure and mortality as fire weather grows more prevalent
A thousand kilometres from the infernos gorging on northern Ontario’s boreal forests, Erin O’Connor watched the sky above Canada’s biggest city turn an “almost post-apocalyptic” orange as it filled with light-scattering particles of soot and ash. Stepping outside the halls of Toronto General hospital, where air filters were keeping patients safe from the worst of the fumes, she was struck by a smell so strong it felt like standing by a campfire.
“It really hit you in the face as soon as you walked outside,” said O’Connor, who runs University Health Network’s emergency department and saw a rise in patients presenting with allergies and shortness of breath. “As the days progressed, it was like that everywhere. It seemed even inside you could smell that burning.”
 Continue reading...

articles.description: The Norwegian Football Federation calls for Fifa president Gianni Infantino to resign after he attempted to sell off stakes in the World Cup.
articles.titleJa: ノルウェー、インファンティーノFIFA会長の辞任を要求 メキシコとCONMEBOLは支持
articles.summary: ノルウェーサッカー連盟は、ワールドカップの権益売却を試みたFIFA会長ジャンニ・インファンティーノの辞任を要求。一方でメキシコとCONMEBOLの会長はインファンティーノを支持しています。

articles.title: Ukraine hits two oil refineries deep in Russian territory
articles.description: Ukraine's president says the strikes aim to limit revenues Russia "used to finance" its war.
articles.titleJa: ウクライナ、ロシア領奥深くの石油精製所2ヶ所を攻撃
articles.summary: ウクライナ軍がロシア領内の石油精製所2ヶ所を攻撃。ウクライナ大統領は、これらの攻撃がロシアが戦争資金に充てている収入を制限することを目的としていると述べています。

articles.title: Man behind deadly Munich car ramming handed life sentence
articles.description: Farhad N, who is found guilty of killing two and injuring dozens more, will likely not be released from prison.
articles.titleJa: ミュンヘンでの致命的な車両突入事件の犯人に終身刑
articles.summary: ミュンヘンで2人を殺害し数十人を負傷させた車両突入事件の犯人ファルハドNが有罪となり、終身刑を言い渡されました。刑務所から釈放される可能性は低いと見られています。

articles.title: EU commends Spain's 'swift response' to Ceuta migrant crisis
articles.description: About 70,000 of the 72,000 people who came to Ceuta illegally last week have been returned to Morocco, Spain says.
articles.titleJa: EU、スペインのセウタ移民危機への「迅速な対応」を称賛
articles.summary: EUは、スペインの飛び地セウタで発生した移民危機に対するスペインの「迅速な対応」を称賛。スペインによると、先週不法入国した約7万2千人のうち、約7万人がモロッコに送還されました。

articles.title: Bono, Eddie Vedder and Hozier among mourners at Glen Hansard's funeral
articles.description: The 56-year-old, who shot to prominence in 1991 musical comedy film The Commitments, died in a motorcycle crash last week.
articles.titleJa: グレン・ハンサードの葬儀にボノ、エディ・ヴェダー、ホージアらが参列
articles.summary: 1991年のミュージカルコメディ映画「ザ・コミットメンツ」で有名になったグレン・ハンサード氏の葬儀が執り行われ、ボノ、エディ・ヴェダー、ホージアといった著名なミュージシャンらが参列しました。彼は先週、オートバイ事故で56歳で亡くなりました。

articles.title: Video shows Russian drone chasing Ukrainian street vendor in 'human safari' attack
articles.description: Ukraine said the video - showing a terrified civilian being hounded by a remotely controlled drone - amounted to a war crime.
articles.titleJa: ロシアのドローンがウクライナの露天商を「人間狩り」攻撃する動画が公開
articles.summary: ロシアのドローンが恐怖に怯えるウクライナの民間人を追い回す「人間狩り」のような攻撃の動画が公開され、ウクライナはこの行為を戦争犯罪と主張しています。

articles.title: Mourners line streets of Milan for legend Baresi's funeral
articles.description: Thousands gather on the streets of Milan for the funeral of legendary former AC Milan and Italy defender Franco Baresi.
articles.titleJa: ミラノの街路にレジェンド、バレージ氏の葬儀参列者が列をなす
articles.summary: ACミランとイタリア代表の伝説的ディフェンダー、フランコ・バレージ氏の葬儀がミラノで執り行われ、数千人の参列者が街路に集まり、故人を偲びました。

articles.title: US offers $1bn to Colombia on new right-wing president's first day of office
articles.description: Abelardo de la Espriella used his maiden speech to promise an "all-out war" on what he calls "narco-terrorism".
articles.titleJa: 米国、コロンビア新右派大統領就任初日に10億ドルを提供
articles.summary: 米国がコロンビア新大統領の就任初日に10億ドルを供与。新大統領は「麻薬テロ」に全面戦争を宣言した。

articles.title: Brazilian top-flight club wear name of English fan with MND on shirts
articles.description: Brazilian top flight club Coritiba wear the name of an English fan from Norwich on their shirts to raise awareness of motor neurone disease.
articles.titleJa: ブラジルのトップリーグクラブ、筋萎縮性側索硬化症の英国人ファンの名前をユニフォームに着用
articles.summary: ブラジルのサッカークラブ、コリチーバが、筋萎縮性側索硬化症を患う英国人ファンの名前をユニフォームに着用し、病気の啓発活動を行った。

articles.title: Messi's father Jorge dies aged 68 after illness
articles.description: Lionel Messi's father and agent Jorge dies at the age of 68 following a long illness.
articles.titleJa: メッシの父ホルヘ氏、68歳で病死
articles.summary: リオネル・メッシの父であり代理人でもあったホルヘ氏が、長期にわたる闘病の末、68歳で死去した。

articles.title: Mexico and Peru restore diplomatic relations after asylum row
articles.description: Relations broke down after former Peruvian Prime Minister Betssy Chávez sought asylum in the Mexican embassy in November 2025.
articles.titleJa: メキシコとペルー、亡命問題の後、外交関係を修復
articles.summary: 亡命問題で断絶していたメキシコとペルーの外交関係が修復された。元ペルー首相がメキシコ大使館に亡命を求めたことが発端だった。

articles.title: Livestreamer's murder raises questions over relations between Mexico's creators and cartels
articles.description: The murder of content creator César Gastélum on Tuesday raises questions about why influencers are coming under attack.
articles.titleJa: ライブ配信者の殺害、メキシコのクリエイターとカルテルの関係に疑問を投げかける
articles.summary: メキシコでライブ配信者が殺害された事件は、同国のコンテンツクリエイターと麻薬カルテルとの関係、そしてインフルエンサーがなぜ狙われるのかについて疑問を提起している。

articles.title: Mexican influencer shot dead during livestream
articles.description: César Gastélum, who was known for comedy and lifestyle posts, was killed at close range by a man on a motorbike.
articles.titleJa: メキシコのインフルエンサー、ライブ配信中に射殺される
articles.summary: コメディやライフスタイルで知られるメキシコのインフルエンサー、セザール・ガステルムが、ライブ配信中にオートバイに乗った男に至近距離から射殺された。

articles.title: 'My grandmother subjected my baby to female genital mutilation behind my back'
articles.description: In Colombia, where FGM is still practised by some members of an indigenous group, a landmark bill banning the practice has been enacted.
articles.titleJa: 「祖母が私の知らない間に赤ちゃんに女性器切除を施した」
articles.summary: コロンビアで、一部の先住民族グループに今も残る女性器切除(FGM)を禁止する画期的な法案が制定された。これは深刻な人権問題への対応だ。

articles.title: On the front line of Ecuador's drugs war, police fight gangs, guns and corruption
articles.description: The BBC goes on patrol with Ecuador's police, who are grappling with a huge surge in drug crime.
articles.titleJa: エクアドルの麻薬戦争の最前線で、警察がギャング、銃、汚職と闘う
articles.summary: エクアドル警察は麻薬犯罪の急増に直面し、ギャング、銃器、そして組織内の汚職と闘う最前線にいる。

articles.title: One month after earthquakes, Venezuelans still search for loved ones and answers
articles.description: As families continue to look for missing loved ones, there is growing anger and resentment at the authorities.
articles.titleJa: 地震から1ヶ月、ベネズエラの人々は愛する人々と答えを探し続ける
articles.summary: 地震発生から1ヶ月が経過したが、ベネズエラでは多くの家族が未だに行方不明の愛する人を探しており、当局への怒りと不満が高まっている。

articles.title: This farmer wanted to quit the cocaine industry - he couldn't
articles.description: Colombians who grow cocaine's raw material bemoan a lack of support to help them switch crops.
articles.titleJa: この農民はコカイン産業から抜け出したかったが、できなかった
articles.summary: コカイン原料を栽培するコロンビアの農民たちは、他の作物への転換を支援する体制が不足していることに不満を漏らしている。

articles.title: In Brazil, court ruling sheds light on the story of an undocumented and stateless woman
articles.description: After 40 years without documents or an official identity, a woman born in Bolivia was able to regularize her immigration status and begin the process of recognition as a stateless person.
articles.titleJa: ブラジル、裁判所の判決が無国籍で書類のない女性の物語に光を当てる
articles.summary: 40年間書類なしで生きてきたボリビア生まれの女性が、ブラジルで移民としての地位を合法化し、無国籍者としての認定プロセスを開始した。

articles.title: Venezuela is burning, and I’m forced to watch from afar
articles.description: From Mexico City, an exiled Venezuelan watches her homeland collapse in real time, confronting the helplessness of displacement, authoritarian neglect, and the unbearable distance between survival and home.
articles.titleJa: ベネズエラが燃えている、そして私は遠くから見るしかない
articles.summary: メキシコシティに亡命中のベネズエラ人が、祖国の崩壊を目の当たりにし、避難生活の無力感、権威主義的放置、故郷との耐え難い距離に直面している。

articles.title: Weaponizing citizenship: Silencing dissent in Nicaragua
articles.description: In this edition, we examine an authoritarian narrative making the case for denationalization in Nicaragua.
articles.titleJa: 市民権を武器にする：ニカラグアでの反体制派の沈黙化
articles.summary: ニカラグアで、権威主義政権が市民権剥奪を正当化し、反体制派を沈黙させる試みを検証。市民権が武器として使われている状況が浮き彫りに。

articles.title: How much will it take to rebuild Venezuela after the earthquakes?
articles.description: Early damage estimates vary widely, but all point to the same conclusion: rebuilding Venezuela will require unprecedented financial resources and long-term economic recovery efforts.
articles.titleJa: 地震後のベネズエラを再建するにはどれくらいの費用がかかるのか？
articles.summary: 地震後のベネズエラの再建には、前例のない財源と長期的な経済復興努力が必要となるとの試算。被害は甚大で、その費用は多大。

articles.title: From Mexico to Venezuela: A diaspora’s race to save lives
articles.description: From Mexico, Venezuelans mobilized within hours, building trusted networks to deliver aid and proving that solidarity can cross any border.
articles.titleJa: メキシコからベネズエラへ：ディアスポラによる命を救う競争
articles.summary: メキシコから、ベネズエラ人たちが数時間で動員され、信頼できるネットワークを構築して援助を提供。国境を越える連帯を示した。

articles.title: How an AI research tool helped challenge support for police violence in Brazil
articles.description: In 2023, Brazil recorded 45,747 intentional violent deaths — among the highest rates in the world. Like many democracies, the country has long grappled with the issue of large-scale public support for state violence.
articles.titleJa: AI研究ツールがブラジルにおける警察の暴力支持に異議を唱えるのにどう役立ったか
articles.summary: 2023年に暴力死が多発したブラジルで、AI研究ツールが国家暴力への大規模な国民の支持に異議を唱え、社会問題解決に貢献。

articles.title: 70 years on, Argentine court declares ‘Operation Massacre’ a crime against humanity
articles.description: The victims’ families testified in court for the first time: "We want justice served. Even though their killers are no longer here, I want the truth known.”
articles.titleJa: 70年を経て、アルゼンチン裁判所が「虐殺作戦」を人道に対する罪と認定
articles.summary: 70年前の「虐殺作戦」について、アルゼンチン裁判所が人道に対する罪と認定。犠牲者遺族が初めて法廷で証言し、真実と正義を求めた。

articles.title: Venezuela earthquakes reveal a child protection system unprepared for disaster
articles.description: After Venezuela’s earthquakes, families searched for missing children within a strained protection system that struggled to respond amid collapsed buildings, scarce resources, and institutional gaps.
articles.titleJa: ベネズエラの地震、災害に備えのない児童保護システムを露呈
articles.summary: ベネズエラ地震後、崩壊した建物や資源不足、制度的欠陥の中で、児童保護システムが対応に苦慮。多くの家族が行方不明の子供たちを探した。

articles.title: Why Venezuela’s earthquakes were so devastating: Geology, vulnerability, and years of structural neglect
articles.description: The dual earthquakes revealed how geology, corruption, and a longstanding humanitarian emergency amplified destruction across La Guaira, Caracas and seven other Venezuelan cities.
articles.titleJa: ベネズエラの地震がなぜこれほど壊滅的だったのか：地質、脆弱性、そして長年の構造的放置
articles.summary: ベネズエラの二つの地震が壊滅的だったのは、地質、汚職、長年の人道危機が複合的に破壊を増幅させたためと判明。

articles.title: Follow the story: Local journalists, media and advocates covering Venezuela’s earthquakes
articles.description: From La Guaira to affected communities nationwide, these Venezuelan voices are documenting the disaster and helping people find reliable information.
articles.titleJa: 物語を追う：ベネズエラの地震を報道する地元ジャーナリスト、メディア、活動家たち
articles.summary: ラ・グアイラから全国の被災地まで、ベネズエラの声が地震災害を記録し、人々が信頼できる情報を見つけるのを支援している。

articles.title: An Indian cash scheme for women drops nine million beneficiaries - 29,000 were men
articles.description: India's largest cash-transfer scheme for women in Maharashtra state is facing scrutiny over alleged lapses.
articles.titleJa: インドの女性向け現金給付制度、900万人の受給者から2万9千人が男性と判明し除外
articles.summary: インドのマハラシュトラ州で行われている女性向け現金給付制度で、不備が指摘され、受給資格のない2万9千人の男性が除外された。

articles.title: India police fire tear gas at protesters seeking exam reforms
articles.description: Thousands of students and job seekers have gathered in Jharkhand state, weeks after the "cockroach" protests took place in Delhi.
articles.titleJa: インド警察、試験改革を求める抗議者に催涙ガスを発射
articles.summary: ジャールカンド州で数千人の学生や求職者が集まり、試験改革を求めて抗議活動を行ったところ、警察が催涙ガスを発射した。

articles.title: Thai school shooter learnt how to use guns via social media
articles.description: Police say they are still investigating the 14-year-old shooter's motive.
articles.titleJa: タイの学校銃撃犯、ソーシャルメディアで銃器使用を習得
articles.summary: タイの学校銃撃事件の14歳の犯人がソーシャルメディアを通じて銃器の使用方法を学んだと警察が発表。動機は現在も調査中。

articles.title: Typhoon Dolphin batters Japan's Okinawa before bearing down on China
articles.description: The storm has cut power to at least 44,000 buildings and injured five people on the Japanese island.
articles.titleJa: 台風ドルフィン、沖縄を襲った後中国へ向かう
articles.summary: 台風ドルフィンが日本の沖縄を直撃し、4万4千棟以上の建物が停電し、5人が負傷した。その後、中国へ進路を変えている。

articles.title: Australia is the planet's extinction hotspot, but one animal offers a glimmer of hope
articles.description: The country is home to some of the world's most unique species - but it is losing them at an alarming rate.
articles.titleJa: オーストラリアは地球の絶滅ホットスポットだが、ある動物が希望の光を示す
articles.summary: オーストラリアは世界で最も多くの固有種が生息するが、それらを驚くべき速さで失っている。しかし、ある動物が希望を与えている。

articles.title: Thai PM vows to introduce stricter gun laws after eight killed in shooting
articles.description: Eight people were killed when a 14-year-old opened fire at his home and school before shooting himself dead.
articles.titleJa: タイ首相、銃撃事件で8人死亡を受け厳格な銃規制法導入を公約
articles.summary: 14歳の少年による銃撃事件で8人が死亡したことを受け、タイ首相はより厳格な銃規制法の導入を約束した。

articles.title: Moment earthquake shakes hospital operating room in Japan
articles.description: Security camera footage shows doctors shielding a patient on the operating table as last month's magnitude 6.8 quake shook Kumamoto General Hospital.
articles.titleJa: 日本の病院手術室が地震で揺れる瞬間
articles.summary: 先月のマグニチュード6.8の地震で熊本総合病院の手術室が揺れ、医師が手術台の患者を覆い隠す様子が防犯カメラ映像に捉えられた。

articles.title: A new youth agitation grips an Indian state after 'cockroach' protests
articles.description: Weeks after the CJP protests shook Delhi, a new youth-led movement over jobs and recruitment is gathering force in Jharkhand.
articles.titleJa: 「ゴキブリ」デモ後、新たな若者の暴動がインドの州を襲う
articles.summary: デリーを揺るがしたCJPデモの数週間後、ジャールカンド州で職と採用を巡る新たな若者主導の運動が勢いを増している。

articles.title: How a schoolteacher's son became Kashmir's first India Test cricketer
articles.description: Auqib Nabi becomes Jammu and Kashmir's first cricketer to get India Test call-up, inspiring millions.
articles.titleJa: カシミール初のインド代表テストクリケット選手、ある教師の息子が誕生
articles.summary: アクィブ・ナビがジャンムー・カシミール州から初のインド代表テストクリケット選手となり、数百万人にインスピレーションを与えている。

articles.title: He's been frozen on Everest for 30 years, now 'Green Boots' may finally be coming home
articles.description: For decades, an Indian man's lime shoes have been a grim trail marker for many climbing the world's highest peak.
articles.titleJa: エベレストで30年間凍結されていた「グリーンブーツ」、ついに故郷へ帰還か
articles.summary: 数十年間、エベレストの登山道で目印となっていたインド人男性の遺体「グリーンブーツ」が、ついに故郷に戻される可能性が出てきた。

articles.title: United Kingdom launches safeguard investigation on polyethylene terephthalate
articles.description: On 5 August 2026, the United Kingdom notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards that it had initiated, on the same day, a safeguard investigation on imports of certain polyethylene terephthalate (PET).
articles.titleJa: 英国がポリエチレンテレフタレートに関するセーフガード調査を開始
articles.summary: 英国が2026年8月5日、ポリエチレンテレフタレート（PET）の輸入に関するセーフガード調査を開始したことをWTOに通告した。

articles.title: World Trade and Tech Day to explore policies to make AI work for inclusive trade
articles.description: The WTO will host the first World Trade and Tech Day on 14 September at its headquarters in Geneva, bringing together trade and information and communications technology (ICT) policymakers, industry leaders and other stakeholders to discuss how artificial intelligence (AI) strategies can better support economies' efforts to maximize the gains of international trade.
articles.titleJa: 世界貿易技術デー、AIを包摂的な貿易に活用する政策を模索
articles.summary: WTOは9月14日にジュネーブで第1回世界貿易技術デーを開催し、AI戦略が国際貿易をどう支援するかを議論する。

articles.title: Global goods trade resilient in the first quarter of 2026 despite war in Middle East
articles.description: World merchandise trade growth exceeded expectations in the first quarter of 2026 as surging trade in electronic components related to artificial intelligence (AI) offset the negative impact of the conflict in the Middle East, which began in the final month of the quarter. Trade disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz are expected to be more fully captured in trade data for the next quarter.
articles.titleJa: 中東紛争にもかかわらず、2026年第1四半期のグローバル物品貿易は堅調
articles.summary: 2026年第1四半期の国際物品貿易は、AI関連の電子部品貿易が中東紛争の影響を相殺し、予想を上回る成長を見せた。

articles.title: Brazil initiates dispute regarding additional duties imposed by the United States
articles.description: Brazil has requested WTO dispute consultations with the United States regarding additional US duties on products originating in Brazil as a result of two investigations by the United States under Section 301 of the US Trade Act of 1974. Brazil said the additional duties are above the duties otherwise applicable under the US harmonized tariff schedule. The request was circulated to WTO members on 30 July.
articles.titleJa: ブラジル、米国による追加関税について紛争解決協議を提起
articles.summary: ブラジルは、米国がブラジル製品に課している追加関税について、WTOに紛争解決協議を要請した。

articles.title: WTO panel issues report regarding Turkish measures on EVs and other types of vehicles
articles.description: On 28 July, the WTO circulated the panel report in the case brought by China in "Türkiye — Measures Concerning Electric Vehicles and Other Types of Vehicles from China" (DS629).
articles.titleJa: WTOパネル、トルコによるEVなどの車両に関する措置について報告書を発行
articles.summary: WTOは7月28日、中国が提起した「トルコ—電気自動車およびその他の車両に関する措置」訴訟のパネル報告書を配布した。

articles.title: Lithuania gives EUR 30,000 to help developing economies and LDCs improve trade skillset
articles.description: Lithuania is contributing EUR 30,000 (approximately CHF 28,000) in 2026 to finance training programmes for government officials from developing economies, including least-developed countries (LDCs). This contribution to the WTO Global Trust Fund will support these economies in deepening their expertise on WTO issues and help them participate more effectively in the rules-based multilateral trading system.
articles.titleJa: リトアニア、途上国とLDCの貿易スキル向上に3万ユーロを寄付
articles.summary: リトアニアは、途上国および後発開発途上国の政府職員の貿易スキル向上を支援するため、2026年に3万ユーロをWTOグローバル信託基金に拠出する。

articles.title: Uzbekistan reaffirms 2026 WTO accession goal, thanks members for continuing engagement
articles.description: Uzbekistan reaffirmed its determination to complete its WTO accession process within 2026 at a meeting of the Working Party on the Accession of Uzbekistan on 27 and 28 July, soon after its last meeting in March. The head of Uzbekistan's delegation, Chief Negotiator Azizbek Urunov, stressed that maintaining a strong pace of engagement and addressing members' remaining concerns will be critical to bringing the accession process to a successful conclusion.

articles.title: Russia requests dispute panel on EU carbon border adjustment and emissions trading scheme
articles.description: At a meeting of the Dispute Settlement Body (DSB) on 24 July, members considered a request from the Russian Federation for the establishment of a dispute panel to review the European Union's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) Package and alleged export subsidy under the EU scheme for trading greenhouse gas emission allowances. The DSB Chair, Ambassador Guilherme de Aguiar Patriota (Brazil), also updated members on dispute settlement reform consultations and convened an informal discussion after the meeting to further hear members' views.

articles.title: Why is transit in goods free but trade is not?
articles.description: In my previous two posts on the value of the WTO, I argued that when governments set trade policies independently, they focus on domestic effects but often overlook the costs imposed on trading partners. International trade agreements help governments take account of these cross-border spillovers (terms-of-trade externalities) by encouraging reciprocal negotiations over trade policy. While these negotiations will reduce trade protection, they will not necessarily lead to free trade. But if governments do not generally commit themselves to free trade, why has freedom of transit for goods been seen differently?
articles.titleJa: なぜ物品の輸送は自由なのに貿易はそうではないのか？
articles.summary: 貿易政策が国内効果に焦点を当てがちな中、なぜ物品の自由な輸送は認められるのに、自由貿易は必ずしも実現しないのかを考察する。

articles.title: Updated WTO-IMF TPA Index shows continued rise in global trade policy activity
articles.description: A new Trade Policy Activity (TPA) index by WTO and IMF economists shows a marked rise in trade policy activity during 2025-26, alongside heightened trade policy tensions among large economies, against the backdrop of an overall upward trend.
articles.titleJa: 更新されたWTO-IMF TPA指数、世界の貿易政策活動の継続的な増加を示す
articles.summary: WTOとIMFのエコノミストによる新しい貿易政策活動（TPA）指数は、2025年から2026年にかけて貿易政策活動が著しく増加していることを示している。
